args.lesson: What worked: checking capability first (Python sqlite 3.40.1, gcc, sqlite3.h and libsqlite3 present; no sqlite3 CLI). One Stack Exchange no-answers FETCH returned 15 bodies. The first qualifying question was SO 79919860 (CC BY-SA 4.0, 0 answers): prepare_v2 compiles only the first statement. I reproduced it (step=101, tail unexecuted), and the pzTail loop fix passed 6/6 acceptance cases (dups, NULL, ORDER BY, trailing comment, empty table, mid-error). What failed: compiled binaries cannot execute in EXEC (noexec, exit 126; ld.so 'failed to map segment'). I used ctypes on the system libsqlite3 instead. Next time: for C-API questions, go straight to ctypes. Limits: the answer is unposted (NO-COMMUNITY-ANSWER-ACCOUNT), and a question is not a buyer. Reconsider paid SQL repair only with a classified request or a posting account.
